projects.title: MCP - Weather Service for LLMs
projects.detailed_description: This project represents a sophisticated integration of multiple weather data sources and AI forecasting models through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The service acts as a bridge between historical satellite data from EUMETSAT and cutting-edge AI weather prediction models like Google's GraphCast and ECMWF's AIFS.
technical_challenges: Integrating heterogeneous weather data sources with different formats and APIs
Implementing efficient data pipelines for large satellite datasets
Creating a unified interface that abstracts complex weather model differences
Ensuring real-time performance for LLM context integration
Handling temporal data alignment between historical and forecast data
architecture_decisions: Chose FastAPI for high-performance async request handling
Implemented MCP protocol for seamless LLM integration
Used Docker for consistent deployment across environments
Designed modular architecture to easily add new weather data sources
key_features: Historical EUMETSAT satellite data integration
Google GraphCast AI weather prediction integration
ECMWF AIFS forecasting system integration
MCP protocol implementation for LLM context
Unified API for multiple weather data sources
Real-time weather data processing and serving
projects.business_impact: Enables LLMs to access comprehensive weather data for climate analysis, agricultural planning, and environmental research applications

projects.title: Trade Promotion Management MCP Server
projects.detailed_description: An innovative MCP server that demonstrates AI-powered trade promotion management by connecting a FastAPI backend service directly to Claude Desktop. This project showcases the practical implementation of the Model Context Protocol for real-world business applications.
technical_challenges: Implementing MCP protocol specification correctly for Claude Desktop integration
Designing efficient trade promotion data models and business logic
Creating seamless AI agent workflows for trade management tasks
Ensuring secure and reliable API connectivity between services
Building intuitive interfaces that leverage AI capabilities effectively
architecture_decisions: FastAPI chosen for robust async API performance and automatic OpenAPI documentation
MCP protocol implementation for direct Claude Desktop integration
Docker containerization for consistent deployment and scaling
Modular service design for easy extension and maintenance
key_features: Direct Claude Desktop integration via MCP protocol
AI-powered trade promotion analysis and recommendations
Automated trade position management workflows
Real-time data processing and decision support
Comprehensive API documentation and testing suite
projects.business_impact: Demonstrates how AI agents can be integrated into business workflows to automate complex decision-making processes in trade management

projects.title: Tuna Fisheries Data Exploration Tools
projects.detailed_description: A comprehensive data exploration and analysis platform specifically designed for tuna fisheries research. The project combines advanced data processing capabilities with intuitive visualization tools to support fisheries scientists and policy makers in understanding catch patterns, effort distribution, and geospatial trends.
technical_challenges: Processing large-scale fisheries datasets with complex temporal and spatial dimensions
Creating efficient data aggregation algorithms for catch and effort analysis
Implementing interactive geospatial visualizations for purse seine data
Designing responsive web interfaces that work across different devices
Ensuring data accuracy and consistency across multiple fisheries databases
architecture_decisions: Python backend for robust data processing and statistical analysis
Vanilla JavaScript frontend for maximum performance and minimal dependencies
Client-side rendering for fast, interactive user experience
Modular component design for easy maintenance and extension
key_features: Interactive catch and effort data visualization
Geospatial analysis of purse seine fishing activities
Temporal trend analysis with customizable time ranges
Export capabilities for further analysis in research tools
Responsive design optimized for both desktop and mobile use
projects.domain_expertise: Leverages deep understanding of fisheries science, data management practices, and regulatory requirements from IATTC experience
projects.business_impact: Supports evidence-based fisheries management decisions and contributes to sustainable tuna fishing practices

projects.title: PyADMB - Python Wrapper for ADMB
projects.detailed_description: A modern Python interface for AD Model Builder (ADMB), designed to bring advanced automatic differentiation and optimization capabilities to fisheries stock assessment and ecological modeling. This project bridges the gap between ADMB's powerful computational engine and Python's data science ecosystem.
technical_challenges: Creating seamless integration between Python and ADMB's C++ core
Implementing robust error handling and debugging capabilities
Designing intuitive Python APIs that preserve ADMB's mathematical rigor
Ensuring cross-platform compatibility across different operating systems
Optimizing performance for large-scale ecological models
architecture_decisions: Python wrapper design to maintain ADMB's computational performance
Object-oriented interface for intuitive model building and execution
Comprehensive error handling and logging for debugging complex models
Modular design allowing easy extension for new ADMB features
key_features: Pythonic interface to ADMB's automatic differentiation capabilities
Integrated optimization algorithms for parameter estimation
Support for complex ecological and fisheries stock assessment models
Comprehensive documentation and examples for researchers
Cross-platform compatibility for diverse research environments
projects.domain_expertise: Built on extensive experience with fisheries modeling, stock assessment methodologies, and scientific computing requirements
projects.business_impact: Enables researchers to leverage Python's data science tools while accessing ADMB's specialized optimization capabilities for ecological modeling
